name: Lock On sample cards
source: Fictional placeholder cards written for Lock On development. They follow the shape of Gundam Card Game data but contain no official card text or artwork.

cards.name: Lancer Frame
cards.text: <Repair 1> (At the end of your turn, this Unit recovers 1 HP.)

cards.text: <Blocker> (Rest this Unit to change the target of an enemy attack to this Unit.)

cards.text: 【Deploy】 Draw 1 card, then discard 1 card.

cards.text: 【When Paired】 Choose 1 enemy Unit with 3 or less HP. Rest it.
